title: Slow Cooker Indian Butter Chickpeas
subtitle: with Silverbeet and Rice
description: We’re bringing you special recipes to make in your slow cooker! The ultimate in delicious, comforting goodness, they’re so darned simple – just follow the easy steps and watch your cooker do all the work. You can also cook this recipe in the oven using a casserole dish. If using a slow cooker, the cook time is about 8 hrs; if using a casserole dish, it's about 2 hrs.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat your slow cooker to low or preheat the oven to 150C, fan-forced. Thinly slice the silverbeet stems, then coarsely chop the leaves. Cover and chill the leaves until required. Coarsely chop the onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Slow cooker method: If using the slow cooker, combine the silverbeet stems, onion, garlic, chickpeas, tomatoes, cream, masala seasoning, 1 tbs tomato paste, 10g butter and 1½ tsp sugar in the slow cooker bowl. Season with salt and pepper, then cover and cook on low for 7 hours 40 mins.

Casserole method: If using the casserole dish, combine the silverbeet stems, onion, garlic, chickpeas, tomatoes, cream, masala seasoning, 1 tbs tomato paste, 10g butter and 1½ tsp sugar in a medium casserole dish. Season with salt and pepper, then cover and bring to the boil. Transfer the dish to the oven and bake, covered, for 1 hour 40 mins.

Add silverbeet: Add the silverbeet leaves to the chickpea mixture and stir to combine. Cook, covered, in the slow cooker or oven for a further 20 mins or until the silverbeet leaves are tender. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Cook rice and serve up: Meanwhile, rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork. Divide the rice and chickpea curry among bowls and enjoy!
Make it spicy: Chilli lovers, go wild and scatter over chopped bird's eyes to serve.
